'''July 2001 Madison tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Misty Mountain, Madison, Wisconsin on 14 July 2001. [[Brandon Schele]] won it. It is known from Brandon Schele's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2635">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-madison-wi-7-14-01-the-blind-approachd2635/ madison-wi-7-14-01-the-blind-approach], DeckTech (Brandon "Jedi Genius" Schele, 15 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-madison-wi-7-14-01-the-blind-approachd2635/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Misty Mountain, Madison, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brandon Schele]]
